method:
Per academic season, for every player on a named university squad (data/raw/university_rosters):
  team credit (80%)  the best result of a team they were on, at an event they were on the squad for, that season, 0-100. Event points (same shape as club Nationals):
                     Div 1 nationals 1.0, Div 2 0.45, Div 3 / Shield 0.2, regionals 0.1, each x (0.25 + 0.75 x share of the field beaten);
                     outdoor counts in full, indoor x0.85, beach x0.6. Scaled so the season's best result = 100.
  attendance (20%)   events played that season, capped at 5.
No individual stats exist for university events, so there is no production or role component.
Standing: recency-weighted mean of season scores (weights 1, .8, .6, .45 newest first), pulled towards 30 when a player has one season only.
